name: easyhawk-csv-api
description: Production-ready Express API for CSV upload and job tracking

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "cross-env PORT=3001 node src/server.js" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3001/health && npm run dev --prefix ../frontend"
scripts.dev:watch: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "cross-env PORT=3001 node --watch src/server.js" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:3001/health && npm run dev --prefix ../frontend"
